title.english: An Evening With Too Many Windows

pairs.target: cìrì bàngwǎn , xià róng cóng tái jǐng huílái , jìnmén xiān bǎ kōng shuǐhú fàngzài zhuōshàng , dōng de yìshēng , xiàng bǎ zuìhòu yíduànlù yě fàngxià le .
pairs.english: The following evening, Xiarong returned from Moss Well, first setting her empty water flask on the table as she came in: a thump, as though setting down the last stretch of road as well.
pairs.hanzi: 次日傍晚，夏绒从苔井回来，进门先把空水壶放在桌上，咚的一声，像把最后一段路也放下了。

pairs.target: tā dìyīcì zhào yuēdìng de rìzi pǎo zhè tiáo xiàn , yuányǐwéi rènde jǐchù yuànmén jiù gòu , shuízhī tóngyì dǔqiáng jìng kāi zhe sāndào mén , shōuxìn de rén zhù zhōngjiān , yǎng gǒu de rén zhù liǎngbiān .
pairs.english: Running this route on the agreed day for the first time, she had thought recognizing a few courtyard gates would suffice; who knew the same wall had three doors, the letter recipient living in the middle and dog owners on both sides.
pairs.hanzi: 她第一次照约定的日子跑这条线，原以为认得几处院门就够，谁知同一堵墙竟开着三道门，收信的人住中间，养狗的人住两边。

pairs.target: " gǒu dǎo shì quán rènde wǒ le . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “The dogs all recognize me now, at any rate,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: “狗倒是全认得我了。”她说。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gěi tā dǎoshuǐ , wèn xié mó bu mó . tā bǎ jiǎojiān wǎng dèng dǐ suō , shuō xié méishì , shì tā wèn dé xiàng mài xié de .
pairs.english: Tavi poured her water and asked whether the shoes rubbed. She tucked her toes beneath the stool, saying the shoes were fine; he sounded like a shoe seller.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维给她倒水，问鞋磨不磨。她把脚尖往凳底缩，说鞋没事，是他问得像卖鞋的。

pairs.target: jīnrì de xìn dōu jiāodào le , yìjiā shōuhuò pù què xiǎng bǎ hòuxiàng liǎnghù yě sāijìn tóng yítàng jiàqián lǐ , tā méi yìng , yuē hǎo xiàcì xiān bǎ dìzhǐ liè qīng .
pairs.english: Today's letters had all been delivered, but one receiving shop wanted two households in the rear alley included in the same trip's price; she hadn't agreed, arranging to list the addresses clearly first next time.
pairs.hanzi: 今日的信都交到了，一家收货铺却想把后巷两户也塞进同一趟价钱里，她没应，约好下次先把地址列清。

pairs.target: shuō dào zhèlǐ , tā cái cóng xiùlǐ tāochū yìkē yābiǎn de táng , tuī gěi tǎ wéi , shuō gǒu zhǔrén péi de , lùshang méi shědechī .
pairs.english: Only then did she pull a flattened sweet from her sleeve and push it toward Tavi, saying the dog owner had given it as compensation; she'd been unwilling to eat it on the road.
pairs.hanzi: 说到这里，她才从袖里掏出一颗压扁的糖，推给塔维，说狗主人赔的，路上没舍得吃。

pairs.target: fànhòu dù chéng lái jiè chángdèng . shānyāo gōngwū de xiǎo tīng gé jǐrì jiù yǒurén pái qǔzi , jīnyè shǎo gè tái dèngzǐ de , tā bú kèqì dì jiāng tǎ wéi yě suànjìnqù le .
pairs.english: After dinner Du Cheng came to borrow a bench. People rehearsed songs every few days in the hillside communal hall; tonight they lacked a bench carrier, so he unceremoniously counted Tavi in as well.
pairs.hanzi: 饭后杜澄来借长凳。山腰公屋的小厅隔几日就有人排曲子，今夜少个抬凳子的，他不客气地将塔维也算进去了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gēnzhe zǒushàng shítī , bànlù tīngjiàn gèjiā de chuāng lǐ yǒu xǐwǎn , fǎngxiàn hé chǎo háizi de shēngyīn . gāochù de dēng yìzhǎn yā zhe yìzhǎn , kànbùchū nǎ dào qiáng hòumiàn cái zhēnshì shān .
pairs.english: Tavi followed up the stone steps, hearing washing dishes, spinning thread and scolding children through household windows along the way. Lamps overlapped high above, so he couldn't tell behind which wall the actual mountain began.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维跟着走上石梯，半路听见各家的窗里有洗碗、纺线和吵孩子的声音。高处的灯一盏压着一盏，看不出哪道墙后面才真是山。

pairs.target: xiǎo tīng bǐ tā xiǎng de rènào . yígè xiūxié de nánrén qiāo xiǎogǔ , bǔ yúwǎng de lǎofù chàng tóu yíjù , lìng yígè rén zǒng qiǎng zài tā xīqì qián chàng xià jù .
pairs.english: The hall was livelier than he'd expected. A man who repaired shoes played a small drum, an old woman who mended fishing nets sang the first line, and someone else always rushed into the next line before she could breathe in.
pairs.hanzi: 小厅比他想的热闹。一个修鞋的男人敲小鼓，补渔网的老妇唱头一句，另一个人总抢在她吸气前唱下句。

pairs.target: dù chéng qǔchū wěi guǎn , shàngwèi chuīxiǎng , yǐjīng tóng gǔshǒu zhēng qǐ gāi kuài háishì gāi màn . tǎ wéi bǎ chángdèng fàngxià , zuòzài ménbiān , hūrán bùzhī zìjǐ shìbushì gāi zǒu .
pairs.english: Du Cheng took out his reed pipe and, before playing a note, was already arguing with the drummer over whether to go fast or slow. Tavi set down the bench and sat by the door, suddenly unsure whether he should leave.
pairs.hanzi: 杜澄取出苇管，尚未吹响，已经同鼓手争起该快还是该慢。塔维把长凳放下，坐在门边，忽然不知自己是不是该走。

pairs.target: lǎofù zhāoshǒu jiào tā ná zhù yìtiáo kuān bù . bù shàng huà zhe liǎngzuò shān , zhōngjiān liú yídào kōngkǒu , shì xiàxún jùhuì yào yòng de jiù jǐng . ná bù de rén dé děng gē lǐ shuō dào kāi shānmén shí cái lākāi , tǎ wéi tīng le liǎngbiàn , juéde zhè huó zǒng búhuìcuò .
pairs.english: The old woman beckoned him to hold a wide cloth. Two mountains were painted on it with an opening between: old scenery for the gathering later that month. The cloth holders must wait for the song's opening of the mountain gate before pulling it apart; after listening twice, Tavi thought surely he couldn't get this job wrong.
pairs.hanzi: 老妇招手叫他拿住一条宽布。布上画着两座山，中间留一道空口，是下旬聚会要用的旧景。拿布的人得等歌里说到开山门时才拉开，塔维听了两遍，觉得这活总不会错。

pairs.target: dìsānbiàn , tā kāi zǎo le .
pairs.english: On the third run, he opened it too early.
pairs.hanzi: 第三遍，他开早了。

pairs.target: dù chéng chuī dào yíbàn , shānmén hūrán lùchū hòumiàn zhèngzài chī bǐng de gǔshǒu . nà rén zuǐlǐsāi zhe dōngxī , hái hěn jìnzé dì qiāo le yìshēng .
pairs.english: Halfway through Du Cheng's playing, the mountain gate suddenly revealed the drummer eating a flatbread behind it. His mouth stuffed with food, the man still dutifully struck a beat.
pairs.hanzi: 杜澄吹到一半，山门忽然露出后面正在吃饼的鼓手。那人嘴里塞着东西，还很尽责地敲了一声。

pairs.target: lǎofù xiào dé chàng bú xiàqù , tǎ wéi gǎnjǐn hé bù , fǎn bǎ lìngyìtóu chě xié , yízuò shān mànmàn dǎo zài dù chéng tóushàng .
pairs.english: The old woman laughed too hard to keep singing. Tavi hurried to close the cloth, instead pulling the other end askew so that a mountain slowly fell onto Du Cheng's head.
pairs.hanzi: 老妇笑得唱不下去，塔维赶紧合布，反把另一头扯斜，一座山慢慢倒在杜澄头上。

pairs.target: " lù bùtōng le . " gǔshǒu hánhudì shuō .
pairs.english: “The road's blocked,” the drummer said indistinctly.
pairs.hanzi: “路不通了。”鼓手含糊地说。

pairs.target: tāmen zhòng dā bùjǐng , tǎ wéi zhèhuí dīngjǐn lǎofù de yǎnshén , méi zài tīngjiàn shānmén liǎnggè zì jiù dòngshǒu .
pairs.english: They rebuilt the scenery, and this time Tavi watched the old woman's eyes closely, no longer acting the moment he heard the two words mountain gate.
pairs.hanzi: 他们重搭布景，塔维这回盯紧老妇的眼神，没再听见山门两个字就动手。

pairs.target: chàng dào mòwěi shí , wàitou yǒurén qiāo chuāng , sānxià , bǐ gǔshēng qīngchǔ . chuāngwài yígè pī zhe yīfu de nánrén shuō , míngzǎo gǎn dìyī bānchē , háizi gāng shuìzháo , néng bunéng bié zài lái dìwǔbiàn .
pairs.english: Near the song's end someone outside knocked on the window three times, clearer than the drum. A man outside with clothing draped over him said he had the first cart to catch tomorrow morning and his child had just fallen asleep: could they skip a fifth run?
pairs.hanzi: 唱到末尾时，外头有人敲窗，三下，比鼓声清楚。窗外一个披着衣服的男人说，明早赶第一班车，孩子刚睡着，能不能别再来第五遍。

pairs.target: gǔshǒu shuō cái dìsìbiàn , lǎofù dèng tā yìyǎn . tā bìzuǐ , bǎ gǔ sāi dào tuǐ xià . dù chéng wèn néngfǒu zài hé yībiàn qīng de , nánrén bùkěn , zhǐzhe shānshàng de jǐshàn chuāng , shuō búshì zhǐyǒu zìjǐ yìjiā yào zǎoqǐ .
pairs.english: The drummer said it was only the fourth run; the old woman glared at him. He shut up and tucked his drum under his legs. Du Cheng asked for one more quiet run together, but the man refused, pointing to several windows up the slope: his wasn't the only household that had to rise early.
pairs.hanzi: 鼓手说才第四遍，老妇瞪他一眼。他闭嘴，把鼓塞到腿下。杜澄问能否再合一遍轻的，男人不肯，指着山上的几扇窗，说不是只有自己一家要早起。

pairs.target: wūlǐ jìng le yíhuìer , lǎofù jiāng gē zhǐjuǎn qǐlái , shuō jīnwǎn dào zhèlǐ , xiàhuí tízǎo chīfàn , tízǎo kāi .
pairs.english: The room fell quiet for a moment; the old woman rolled up the song sheet, saying that was it for tonight: next time they'd eat earlier and start earlier.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里静了一会儿，老妇将歌纸卷起来，说今晚到这里，下回提早吃饭，提早开。

pairs.target: bān dèng huíqù shí , dù chéng réng dígū báitiān rén còu bùqí . tǎ wéi běn xiǎng shuō fāngcái yǐjīng hěn hǎotīng , yòu juéde nàjùhuà bùnéng tìrén duō shuì bàn kè , zhī bāng tā fúzhù dèng tuǐ .
pairs.english: Carrying the bench back, Du Cheng still grumbled that people couldn't all gather during daylight. Tavi had wanted to say it had already sounded lovely, but felt those words couldn't get anyone a little more sleep, and simply helped steady the bench leg.
pairs.hanzi: 搬凳回去时，杜澄仍嘀咕白天人凑不齐。塔维本想说方才已经很好听，又觉得那句话不能替人多睡半刻，只帮他扶住凳腿。

pairs.target: liǎng rén jīngguò huòchǎng kǒu , xīn tiē de gàoshì hái méi gān , zhǐ jiǎo bèi jiànghu yā dé fāliàng .
pairs.english: The two passed the freight yard entrance. A freshly pasted notice wasn't dry yet, its paper corners pressed shiny with paste.
pairs.hanzi: 两人经过货场口，新贴的告示还没干，纸角被浆糊压得发亮。

pairs.target: míngrì shàngwǔ , huò lù huì jiāng gōngkāi yì dōng chǔliáng méi de yōuxiān bāncì . lái tīng de rén kě cóng cèmén jìn , huòzhǔ , chēduì hé sòngxìnrén ruò yǒu jiù dānjù , yě kě dàilái . tǎ wéi dú dào sòngxìnrén sāngè zì , xiǎngqǐ xià róng xiùlǐ nà kē táng .
pairs.english: Tomorrow morning the freight route association would publicly discuss priority slots for winter grain and coal reserves. Listeners could enter by the side door; cargo owners, cart teams and couriers could bring any previous receipts. Reading the word couriers, Tavi thought of the sweet in Xiarong's sleeve.
pairs.hanzi: 明日上午，货路会将公开议冬储粮煤的优先班次。来听的人可从侧门进，货主、车队和送信人若有旧单据，也可带来。塔维读到送信人三个字，想起夏绒袖里那颗糖。

pairs.target: tā huídào wūlǐ , táng yǐ huà dé nián zhǐ . tā xiǎoxīn bāo le bàntiān , chī dào zuǐlǐ zhǐyǒu yìdiǎndiǎn tián , shǒuzhǐ què quán niánzhù le . gébì yǒurén dī dī hēng qǐ fāngcái de qǔzi , chàng dào shān ménqián tíng le , sìhū yě wàng le xià yíjù .
pairs.english: Back in his room, the sweet had melted onto its paper. He carefully peeled at it for ages: only a little sweetness reached his mouth, while his fingers were all sticky. Someone next door quietly hummed the earlier tune, stopping before the mountain gate, apparently forgetting the next line too.
pairs.hanzi: 他回到屋里，糖已化得粘纸。他小心剥了半天，吃到嘴里只有一点点甜，手指却全粘住了。隔壁有人低低哼起方才的曲子，唱到山门前停了，似乎也忘了下一句。
